description: This file is a shell script that contains a set of tests for the Git command 'diff --no-index'. It sets up temporary directories and files, runs various 'git diff --no-index' commands with different options and pathspecs, and verifies the outputs to ensure correct behavior of the Git diff feature outside of a repository context.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success in execution.

methods.description: Runs a command expecting a specific exit code.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in the output or error of a command.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures the command fails (non-zero exit code).

methods.description: Compares the actual output to an expected output.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes lines to a file or pipe for testing.

methods.description: Calculates a git object ID (hash) for input content.

methods.description: Sets or gets git configuration settings temporarily.
